_meta.purpose: D-139: what the supplement result says from FSSAI's supplement rules and ICMR-NIN's RDA. Sushil 2026-09-30: amounts are shown beside the RDA for men and for women, and the RDA is never called a limit; a tile only above ICMR-NIN's own upper limit.

nutra.title: FSS (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use, Food for Special Medical Purpose and Prebiotic and Probiotic Food) Regulations, 2022, Annexure 1, as operationalised by FSSAI's direction of 18 October 2022

icmr_rda.title: ICMR-NIN, Short Summary Report: Nutrient Requirements for Indians, Recommended Dietary Allowances and Estimated Average Requirements (2020, revised 2024)
icmr_rda.how_read: ICMR-NIN's page embeds the report as a Google Drive file with downloads off; read in the viewer, tables checked on screenshots of the pages

not_compared.folate: Packs print folic acid; ICMR-NIN's table gives folate, and no source read gives the conversion.
not_compared.vitamin_a: Packs print retinol, beta-carotene or IU; the form behind ICMR-NIN's microgram figure isn't stated in the summary tables.
not_compared.vitamin_d_in_micrograms: ICMR-NIN's table is in IU; no source read gives the conversion.
not_compared.biotin_pantothenic_acid: Adequate intake in the report's text, not in table A2.
not_compared.protein: Given per kg of body weight.

statements.text: HEALTH SUPPLEMENT/ NUTRACEUTICAL/ FOOD FOR SPECIAL DIETARY USE/ FOOD FOR SPECIAL MEDICAL PURPOSE/ PREBIOTIC FOOD /PROBIOTIC FOOD
statements.ask: the words "HEALTH SUPPLEMENT" or "NUTRACEUTICAL", in capital and bold letters near the name, on the front

statements.text: Not to exceed the recommended daily usage
match: not to exceed the recommended daily usage
do not exceed the recommended daily
not to exceed the recommended daily
do not exceed the recommended dose
do not exceed the recommended usage
statements.ask: "Not to exceed the recommended daily usage"

statements.text: product is not to be used as a substitute for a varied diet
statements.ask: a statement that the "product is not to be used as a substitute for a varied diet"

statements.text: product is required to be stored out of reach of children
match: away from the reach of children
out of the reach of children
statements.ask: a warning that the "product is required to be stored out of reach of children"
